candidates.transcript_evidence: History, question five. So who was the first president of the United States of America? Was it Thomas Jefferson, John Adams, George Washington, or James Madison?
candidates.description: 提问关于美国第一任总统的选择题
给出答案托马斯·杰斐逊

candidates.transcript_evidence: It was not Jefferson. Jefferson was the third president. But Thomas Jefferson did draft the Declaration of Independence, so they were all involved.
candidates.description: 纠正称杰斐逊是第三任总统，但起草了独立宣言
宣布正确答案是乔治·华盛顿

candidates.transcript_evidence: So George Washington was first. Then John Adams. Then Thomas Jefferson. Then James Madison.
So John Adams was a big advocate for independence. Jefferson drafted the Declaration of Independence. Washington just led during the Revolution, so he was the first president.
candidates.description: 总结三位开国元勋各自主要贡献
